description: Source code for SELinux management in Go, including functions for reading/writing labels, managing contexts, and interacting with the SELinux filesystem.

classes.name: selinuxState
classes.description: Represents the state of SELinux, including whether it is enabled and the mount point.

classes.name: level
classes.description: Represents an MLS level with categories and sensitivity.

classes.name: mlsRange
classes.description: Represents a range of MLS levels with low and high bounds.

classes.name: defaultSECtx
classes.description: Holds context readers and verifier for default SELinux context operations.

methods.name: policyRoot
methods.description: Returns the root path of the SELinux policy based on configuration.

methods.name: setEnable
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of SELinux in the selinuxState struct.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SELinux is enabled, checking mount point if not set.

methods.name: getSELinuxfs
methods.description: Returns the path to the mounted SELinux filesystem.

methods.name: getSelinuxMountPoint
methods.description: Returns the SELinux mount point path.

methods.name: verifySELinuxfsMount
methods.description: Verifies if a given mount point is a valid SELinux filesystem mount.

methods.name: findSELinuxfs
methods.description: Finds the SELinux filesystem mount point.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Reads a configuration value from the SELinux config file.

methods.name: lSetFileLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for a file, not following symlinks.

methods.name: setFileLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for a file, following symlinks.

methods.name: fileLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the SELinux label for a file, following symlinks.

methods.name: lFileLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the SELinux label for a file, not following symlinks.

methods.name: fileLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the SELinux label for a file, following symlinks.

methods.name: setFSCreateLabel
methods.description: Sets the SELinux label for filesystem objects created by the current process.

methods.name: fsCreateLabel
methods.description: Gets the default SELinux label used for filesystem objects created by the process.

methods.name: currentLabel
methods.description: Returns the SELinux label of the current process thread.

methods.name: pidLabel
methods.description: Returns the SELinux label of a given process ID.

methods.name: execLabel
methods.description: Returns the SELinux label used for executed programs.

methods.name: canonicalizeContext
methods.description: Canonicalizes a context string via the kernel.

methods.name: computeCreateContext
methods.description: Computes the context for a class transition.

methods.name: catsToBitset
methods.description: Converts category string to bitset.

methods.name: parseLevelItem
methods.description: Parses a sensitivity or category level item.

methods.name: rangeStrToMLSRange
methods.description: Parses a range string into an mlsRange object.

methods.name: bitsetToStr
methods.description: Converts a category bitset to its string representation.

methods.name: calculateGlbLub
methods.description: Calculates the greatest lower bound and least upper bound of two ranges.

methods.name: readWriteCon
methods.description: Reads or writes a value to a kernel control file.

methods.name: peerLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the SELinux label of a socket peer.

methods.name: setKeyLabel
methods.description: Sets the kernel keyring label for the current thread.

methods.name: keyLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the kernel keyring label for the current thread.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a Context.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new Context object from a label string.

methods.name: clearLabels
methods.description: Clears all reserved labels.

methods.name: reserveLabel
methods.description: Reserves the MLS/MCS level component of a label.

methods.name: selinuxEnforcePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the SELinux enforce mode file.

methods.name: isMLSEnabled
methods.description: Checks if MLS is enabled.

methods.name: enforceMode
methods.description: Returns the current SELinux enforcement mode.

methods.name: setEnforceMode
methods.description: Sets the SELinux enforcement mode.

methods.name: defaultEnforceMode
methods.description: Returns the default system SELinux mode.

methods.name: mcsAdd
methods.description: Adds an MCS label to the state.

methods.name: mcsDelete
methods.description: Removes an MCS label from the state.

methods.name: intToMcs
methods.description: Converts an integer ID to an MCS label string.

methods.name: uniqMcs
methods.description: Generates a unique MCS label.

methods.name: releaseLabel
methods.description: Releases an MLS/MCS label.

methods.name: roFileLabel
methods.description: Returns the read-only file label.

methods.name: loadLabels
methods.description: Loads labels from context files.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Retrieves a label value by key.

methods.name: kvmContainerLabels
methods.description: Returns default labels for KVM containers.

methods.name: initContainerLabels
methods.description: Returns default labels for init system containers.

methods.name: containerLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for general container use.

methods.name: addMcs
methods.description: Adds MLS/MCS labels to process and file labels.

methods.name: securityCheckContext
methods.description: Validates that a context string is understood by the kernel.

methods.name: copyLevel
methods.description: Copies MLS/MCS level from source to destination label.

methods.name: chcon
methods.description: Changes the SELinux label of a file or directory, optionally recursively.

methods.name: rchcon
methods.description: Recursively changes SELinux labels in a directory tree.

methods.name: dupSecOpt
methods.description: Returns security options for container labels based on a process label.

methods.name: findUserInContext
methods.description: Scans a reader for a matching SELinux context.

methods.name: getDefaultContextFromReaders
methods.description: Retrieves default context using provided readers and verifier.

methods.name: getDefaultContextWithLevel
methods.description: Retrieves default context with specified user, level, and scon.
